info.name: SEC EDGAR Data Company Concept Submissions API

params.name: cik
params.description: Central Index Key (CIK) with leading zeros to reach 10 digits. Example: 0000320193 for Apple Inc.

items.docs: Returns a company's complete filing history and metadata identified by Central Index Key (CIK). The response includes company name, SIC code, state of incorporation, addresses, phone number, and a list of recent filings with accession numbers, form types, filing dates, and document metadata. For companies with more than 40 filings, additional files are referenced in the response.
